about: Engine 94 train (coordinator ruling 2026-11-22), as it stands after unit (c) of 2026-11-23: where there are no workers (a test, the dev server) the authoring script check (scriptAnswer.js) runs on the page's main thread, so there it passes the door API a 10 s wall cap of its own (doorDeadline.js::withMainThreadCap); past it the check is refused by name, nothing kept, nothing sent back. No worker path opens a cap. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.
